plugins.readme_text:
**中文** | [English](https://github.com/Oxmyxo/dsh-markji-bridge/blob/main/README.en.md)

# dsh-markji-bridge

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/oxmyxo/dsh-markji-bridge)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 agent 用的墨墨记忆卡（Markji）插件。它在本地维护一份卡组 / 章节 / 卡片缓存，agent 可以搜索、阅读、新建、修改、归档卡片；所有修改先写入本地队列，再按「先拉取、三方合并、后推送」的顺序同步到云端，冲突单独报告，不影响其他卡片。

17 个 `markji_*` 工具，只用 Node 内置模块实现，无第三方依赖。写卡前可先用 `markji_card_syntax` 的 `action=help` 查询原始 Markji 语法，再用 `action=validate` 校验正文；推送时还会检查正文里的图片 / 音频文件是否可用。

## 特性

- **本地缓存**：单个 SQLite 文件 `cache.db`，索引、卡片正文、待推送队列、冲突和同步任务都在一个库里，日常搜索和阅读不请求 API。
- **纯文本搜索**：每张卡另存一列去掉格式标记、图片 / 音频标记、data URI 和 base64 的纯文本，搜索只匹配纯文本，结果干净可读。
- **安全写入**：修改先排队，推送前先拉取远端变更并三方合并，不会用旧数据覆盖云端；冲突按卡片去重，可逐条解决。
- **语法帮助、写前校验与媒体预检**：`markji_card_syntax` 的 `action=help` 可按格式或全部查询原始 Markji 语法；`action=validate` 只检查正文，不生成或改写内容。`markji_sync` 推送前再次校验正文，并批量查询 `Pic` / `Audio` 引用的文件 id。语法错误、文件缺失或查询失败都会记录到该卡并保留队列，不会只写一半。
- **后台同步**：同步任务立即返回句柄，可查进度；进程崩溃或插件重启后用同一句柄续跑，不重复创建云端对象。
- **归档**：把卡片移入同卡组「归档」章节并在正文插入归档说明，重复调用幂等。
- **多进程安全**：同一台机器的多个 DSH 进程可共用一个缓存目录，写入通过文件锁串行。

## 要求

- DSH 0.2.x 的 Host 插件环境
- Node **>= 22.13**（使用内置 `node:sqlite`，无需启动参数）
- Windows / macOS / Linux

## 安装

从 GitHub 获取源码后，把目录安装为 DSH bundle：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Oxmyxo/dsh-markji-bridge.git dsh-markji-bridge
```

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=<仓库目录的绝对路径>
```

升级：

```bash
git pull
```

```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle   target=dsh-markji-bridge
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=<仓库目录的绝对路径>
```

只改了 `lib/` 里的代码时，停用再启用插件即可加载新代码：

```text
plugin_manager set_plugin  target=include:dsh-markji-bridge  enabled=false
plugin_manager set_plugin  target=include:dsh-markji-bridge  enabled=true
```

## 配置 token

在 **DSH 主机进程**的环境变量里设置 Markji OpenAPI token（在[墨墨开放平台](https://open.maimemo.com/)获取）：

```powershell
# Windows：设置用户环境变量后重启 DSH
setx MAIMEMO_MARKJI_OPENAPI_TOKEN "<你的 token>"
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux：写入 shell 配置后重开终端
export MAIMEMO_MARKJI_OPENAPI_TOKEN="<你的 token>"
```

token 不要提交到仓库或写进配置文件。插件配置里的 `apiKey` 可以覆盖 token，但会以明文保存在 profile 配置中，一般不需要。

## 快速开始

```text
markji_decks({ refresh: true })
markji_search({ query: "排序", deck: "算法" })
markji_card_get({ card: "<card_id>" })
markji_card_syntax({ action: "help" })
markji_card_syntax({ action: "help", format: "picture" })
markji_card_syntax({ content: "<Markji 富文本>" })
markji_sync({ mode: "auto" })
```

首次调用会拉取云端数据（卡片多时需要一点时间），之后读操作走本地缓存。状态和进度用 `markji_status` / `markji_sync_status` 查看。

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `markji_decks` | 列出卡组与文件夹 |
| `markji_chapters` | 列出卡组章节 |
| `markji_cards` | 分页 / 搜索本地卡片 |
| `markji_search` | 按卡组名、章节名、纯文本、更新时间快速找卡 |
| `markji_card_get` | 读单张卡：`content`（富文本）+ `text`（纯文本） |
| `markji_card_syntax` | 查询语法帮助（指定格式或全部），或校验原始 Markji 语法 |
| `markji_card_create` | 新建卡片（只接受原始 `content`） |
| `markji_card_update` | 修改卡片内容 |
| `markji_card_archive` | 归档卡片到「归档」章节 |
| `markji_cards_move` | 移动卡片到其他章节 |
| `markji_chapters_edit` | 新建 / 重命名 / 排序章节 |
| `markji_sync` | 启动后台同步（pull / push / auto，可 resume） |
| `markji_sync_status` | 查看同步任务进度与历史 |
| `markji_failures` | 查看失败卡片、冲突与恢复建议 |
| `markji_status` | 插件与缓存总览 |
| `markji_conflict_resolve` | 解决冲突（keep_local / keep_remote / use_content） |
| `markji_file` | 上传文件到 Markji 或查询文件信息 |

## 工具参数与返回值

`?` 表示可选参数。id 都是 Markji OpenAPI id；尚未推送的新对象使用 `local_*` id。工具结果统一为 JSON，超过 `maxOutputChars` 会截断。

| 工具 | 参数 | 返回（主要字段） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markji_decks` | `refresh?` `folder_id?` | `{folders, decks, total, cache}` |
| `markji_chapters` | `deck?` `refresh?` | 指定 `deck`：`{deck_id, deck_name, chapters, cache}`；不指定：`{decks, cache}` |
| `markji_cards` | `deck?` `chapter?` `query?` `limit?` `offset?` | `{total, offset, limit, has_more, cards, cache}` |
| `markji_search` | `query?` `deck?` `deck_name?` `chapter?` `chapter_name?` `updated_after?` `updated_before?` `limit?` `offset?` `refresh?` | `{total, offset, limit, has_more, filters, cards, cache}` |
| `markji_card_get` | `card` `deck?` | `{card}` |
| `markji_card_syntax` | `action?: validate/help`；validate：`content`；help：`format?` | validate：`{ok, errors, warnings, stats, media}`；help：`{ok, action, format, rules, nesting, formats}` |
| `markji_card_create` | `deck` `chapter` `content` `order?` `grammar_version?` | `{ok, card_id, deck_id, chapter_id, status, changed, pending, message}` |
| `markji_card_update` | `card` `content` `grammar_version?` | `{ok, card_id, status, changed, pending, message}` |
| `markji_card_archive` | `cards`（非空数组） | `{ok, archived, content_updated, already_archived, moved, chapters, status, pending, message}` |
| `markji_cards_move` | `cards` `to_chapter` `deck?` `order?` | `{ok, moved, to_chapter_id, status, pending, message}` |
| `markji_chapters_edit` | `action: create/rename/sort`；create：`deck` `name` `order?`；rename：`chapter` `name` `deck?`；sort：`deck` `chapter_ids` | `{ok, action, chapter_id?, deck_id?, chapters?, status, pending, message}` |
| `markji_sync` | `mode?: auto/pull/push` `full?` `resume?` | `{task, already_running?}` |
| `markji_sync_status` | `task_id?` | `{active, tasks}` |
| `markji_failures` | `card?` `deck?` `limit?` | `{ok, summary, conflicts, failed_cards, last_task_errors, recovery, truncated}` |
| `markji_status` | 无 | `{version, data_dir, cache_file, configured, base_url, cache, pending, conflicts, last_sync, last_error, active_task, tasks, auto_sync}` |
| `markji_conflict_resolve` | `id` `strategy: keep_local/keep_remote/use_content` `content?` | `{ok, id, entity, strategy, state, changed}` |
| `markji_file` | `action: upload/query`；upload：`path` `deck?`；query：`ids` `expires?` | upload：`{file}`；query：`{files}` |

### 语法帮助

`markji_card_syntax` 有两种用法：

```text
markji_card_syntax({ action: "help" })                     // 全部格式
markji_card_syntax({ action: "help", format: "picture" })  // 只查图片
markji_card_syntax({ content: "<Markji 富文本>" })         // 校验正文
```

`action=help` 时 `format` 可省略或写 `all`；写 `basic` 只返回通用规则和嵌套限制。支持的格式 id 为 `text-style`、`cloze`、`audio`、`card-ref`、`paragraph`、`choice`、`picture`、`formula`、`answer-line`，也接受对应标签（如 `Pic`）和中文别名（如 `图片`）。帮助内容是静态的，不会检查或改写正文；语法以 [Markji 制卡语法指南](https://tutuji333.github.io/markji-faq/questions/content/card-syntax-guide/) 为准。

### 返回结构

```text
CacheInfo = {
  pulled_at?, last_full_pull_at?, stale: boolean,
  error: string|null, save_error?: string|null,
}

DeckView = {
  id, name, description, card_count, chapter_count,
  updated_time, is_private, source, status, missing,
}

ChapterView = {
  id, name, revision, order, card_count,
  pending: null | object, updated_time, local, missing,
}

CardSummary = {
  id, deck_id, deck_name, chapter_id, chapter_name,
  status: "synced" | "dirty" | "new" | "conflict",
  revision, snippet, updated_time,
}

CardView = {
  id, deck_id, chapter_id, chapter_name,
  content: string, text: string, grammar_version: number,
  status, local: boolean,
  cloud: null | { revision, updated_time },
  pending: null | { content, grammar_version },
  conflict: null | ConflictView,
  last_error: null | { code, message },
  created_time, updated_time,
}

ConflictView = {
  id, kind, entity, deck_id, chapter_id, card_id, op,
  local, remote, state, detected_at,
  deck_name, chapter_name, card_snippet,
  recovery: { tool, arguments, strategies, hint },
}

SyncTask = {

plugins.description: ChemDraw Bridge — a DSH plugin that turns CAS numbers, names, paper/SI PDFs, and SciFinder exports into native ChemDraw source files.
plugins.readme_text:
# ChemDraw Bridge

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges **compound identity** and **literature structures** to native, editable ChemDraw source files on this computer.

It accepts a CAS number, an English/IUPAC compound name, or a compound in a paper/SI PDF.

中文操作说明：[README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

## What it produces

- `"<title> (CID <cid>).cdxml"` — ChemDraw's native XML format. Double-click to open and edit in ChemDraw.
- `"<title> (CID <cid>).cdx"` — optional binary ChemDraw format, useful when inserting an OLE object into Word. Enable with `also_cdx: true`.
- `"<title> (CID <cid>).meta.json"` — provenance: PubChem CID, CAS, formula, InChIKey, SMILES, generation time, ChemDraw version and the validation result.

The `.cdxml` file is written by ChemDraw itself, not hand-authored: the plugin pastes the PubChem isomeric SMILES into a hidden ChemDraw document and saves that document. ChemDraw therefore supplies the layout, implicit hydrogens, charges and stereo wedges.

## How identity is resolved

1. **CAS number** (e.g. `50-78-2`): the check digit is validated locally. PubChem is queried, and the returned CID is accepted only if the exact CAS string appears in that CID's synonym list. A bad check digit or an unconfirmed CAS is rejected rather than guessed.
2. **Name** (e.g. `aspirin`, `L-ascorbic acid`): PubChem autocomplete and ChemicalBook are searched, with prefix probes for common typos. One exact match is used directly; multiple candidates require the operator to select one before generation.
3. **CID** (`CID:2244` or a bare integer): used directly.

Chinese names are resolved through ChemicalBook when possible; CAS remains the most reliable input.

## Fuzzy names and operator selection

A name does not have to be exact:

1. PubChem autocomplete supplies name suggestions, and a few shorter prefixes are probed to catch common typos (`caffiene` → `caffeine`, `asprin` → `aspirin`).
2. ChemicalBook is searched as a secondary, best-effort source; it has no public API and is skipped when unavailable.
3. If one exact match is found, it is drawn directly.
4. If several candidates remain, `draw_from_identifier` returns the ranked list and asks the caller to use `search_compounds`; the operator chooses one, then the caller invokes `draw_from_identifier` with `CID:<cid>`.

CAS numbers and explicit CIDs never go through fuzzy matching.

SciFinder's search API is OAuth/ELN-oriented and returns a path into its web application rather than the result set. The precise route is the export workflow below; PubChem and ChemicalBook remain the fuzzy-search sources.

## SciFinder exports

A logged-in SciFinder user can export the selected substance records and let the plugin read them:

1. In SciFinder, search for the substance, select the target record(s), and export **SDF** (preferred, carries the authoritative structure) or **CSV/TSV** with CAS numbers.
2. Call `import_scifinder(file_path="...")`.
3. The tool returns candidates; the operator chooses one.
4. Draw it with `draw_from_identifier(identifier="SMILES:<smiles>")`, or with `CID:<cid>` when the CSV row resolved to PubChem.

Supported export formats: `.sdf`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.txt`. SDF is read with RDKit and compared with the CDXML after ChemDraw writes it, so the structure does not depend on a name lookup.

## Image recognition and reaction drafts

`recognize_image` runs OSRA on a tight structure image, then validates every SMILES with RDKit:

```text
recognize_image(image_path="E:\\figs\\compound.png")
recognize_image(pdf_path="E:\\paper.pdf", page=5, box=[100, 200, 360, 430])
```

This is for compounds with no printed IUPAC name. The output is a **candidate list**, not a verified identity: OSRA can misread stereochemistry, charges, isotopes and abbreviations. Abbreviated groups such as `PhthN`, `MQ` or `Boc` cannot be reconstructed from pixels; the tool refuses rather than inventing them. Confirm the candidate, then draw it with `draw_from_identifier(identifier="SMILES:<smiles>")`.

`draw_reaction` drafts a one-step scheme from SMILES:

```text
draw_reaction(
  reactants=["CCO"],
  products=["CC=O"],
  conditions="Pd(OAc)2, 80 °C",
  yield_text="82%",
  also_cdx=true
)
```

It places structures, arrow, conditions and yield in one ChemDraw document. This is a layout draft: check arrow direction, stoichiometry, conditions and products before using it in a paper.

## Publication layout

Structures are laid out with RDKit CoordGen, which avoids ChemDraw's tall
clipboard layout for large molecules. ChemDraw then applies the journal-style
defaults used by the plugin:

- Arial 9 pt atom labels;
- 0.4 cm (20 pt) bond length;
- 0.6 pt line width;
- 10 pt bond spacing and 1 pt margin;
- compact reaction arrows, 9 pt conditions/yields and joined plus signs.

The settings are written into the CDXML, so the file stays editable rather than
being a flattened image.

## Literature extraction

`draw_from_paper` extracts a compound from a paper or its supporting information:

1. It reads the PDF text and locates the requested label (for example `3a`) and the IUPAC name printed above it.
2. It resolves that name with the public **OPSIN** name-to-structure service.
3. **RDKit** independently computes the formula and InChIKey; a mismatch is a hard failure.
4. If the SI also prints an HRMS formula (for example `calc. for C27H19N3O4`), the formula is cross-checked, allowing for common `Na`/`K`/`Li` adducts.
5. ChemDraw writes the `.cdxml` / optional `.cdx`.

A real example from `10.1039/c7cc02426f` (compound `3a`):

```text
PDF text  ->  2-((3S,4S)-1-(5-Methoxyquinolin-8-yl)-2-oxo-4-phenylazetidin-3-yl)isoindoline-1,3-dione
OPSIN     ->  COC1=C2C=CC=NC2=C(C=C1)N1C([C@H]([C@@H]1C1=CC=CC=C1)N1C(C2=CC=CC=C2C1=O)=O)=O
RDKit     ->  C27H19N3O4, InChIKey QWWIAFJZFCQLMC-ZEQRLZLVSA-N
HRMS      ->  C27H19N3O4  (match)
```

`source` may be a DOI, a PDF URL, or a local PDF path. Publishers often block automated PDF downloads; in that case pass `local_pdf` with a PDF/SI you downloaded yourself. The DOI is still used for the citation metadata.

The tool refuses to guess when no unambiguous IUPAC name is found. Abbreviated schemes (`PhthN`, `MQ`, `Boc` as labels) cannot be reconstructed by image OCR alone, so a name is the reliable route.

## Verification

Before returning, the plugin:

- parses the generated CDXML and compares its element counts with the source SMILES;
- checks that the heavy-atom count matches;
- checks that fragments and bonds exist;
- checks the `VjCD0100` header when a `.cdx` is requested;
- writes the result into the sidecar JSON.

If the atom composition does not match, the generated files are deleted and the call fails.

## Install

1. Clone or download this repository to a local folder.
2. Run the Python setup once (used by the CoordGen publication layout, `draw_from_paper` and `import_scifinder`):

   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup-python.ps1
   ```

3. In DeepSeek Harness, install that folder as a bundle:

   ```text
   plugin_manager install_bundle(target="E:\\path\\to\\chemdraw-bridge")
   ```

4. Enable the `chemdraw-bridge` plugin row if it is not already active.

For `recognize_image`, also install the small local OCR binary once:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\setup-osra.ps1
```

The `vendor/venv` and `vendor/osra` directories are intentionally not committed; the setup scripts create them.

## Requirements

- Windows with ChemDraw installed and activated (tested with ChemOffice 2022 / ChemDraw 22.0.0.22).
- Network access to `pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov` and `www.chemicalbook.com`; the literature tool also uses `opsin.ch.cam.ac.uk`.
- No API key.

## Tool

`search_compounds`

| Parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | Compound name or partial name (`asprin`, `vitamin c`, `阿司匹林`). Required. |
| `limit` | Maximum candidates, 3–8; default 6. |

Returns ranked candidates with CID, CAS, formula, source and match score. Show them to the operator, then call `draw_from_identifier` with the chosen `CID:<cid>`.

`import_scifinder`

| Parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `file_path` | SciFinder export: `.sdf` (preferred), `.

plugins.description: Ponytail (lazy senior dev mode) for DeepSeek Harness: always-on smallest-complete-change rules and six ponytail skills, one bundle with no slash command.
plugins.readme_text:
# Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) is "lazy senior dev
mode": the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a busy human
understands in one read. This bundle ports it to DeepSeek Harness as one
pluggable unit — switch it on and it applies to every session. There is no slash
command to remember.

## What you get (bundle on = on)

- **Always-on rules.** A prompt section (`ponytail:rules`, order 9500) carries
  `PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE — level: <level>` plus the canonical rules, re-read at
  every step assembly, for every session in this profile, subagents included.
- **Six skills.** The session catalog tells the model to load a skill when a
  request matches, so "review this change" reaches `ponytail-review` without any
  gesture. The five task skills can also be typed as `/ponytail-review`,
  `/ponytail-audit`, `/ponytail-debt`, `/ponytail-gain`, `/ponytail-help`; the
  core `ponytail` skill stays model-only.
- **A configured level.** `defaultMode` in the row config: `off`, `lite`,
  `full` (default) or `ultra`. No command and no state file: turn the bundle on
  and the configured level is what runs.
- **Deactivation phrases.** A whole message that is exactly "stop ponytail" or
  "normal mode" ends the rules for this process run, as upstream does; a bundle
  toggle or restart restores the configured level.

## Levels

| `defaultMode` | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `off` | No rules injected; the six skills still load on demand. |
| `lite` | Build what was asked; name the smaller option in one line. |
| `full` | The rules above. Default. |
| `ultra` | Also question the request before building. |

## Install

Pick any route; all of them install the same bundle (a package with a
`dsh.bundle.patch`).

| Route | Spec to give **Plugins → Add plugin** (or `dsh plugin add`) |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:Vincent-chk/dsh-ponytail` |
| Git URL | `https://github.com/Vincent-chk/dsh-ponytail` |
| Tarball | `npm pack` in a checkout, then the absolute path to the `.tgz` |
| Local checkout | the absolute path of this directory |

**From the plugin market:** add this index source in
**Plugins → Discover → Add index source** and install from the card:

```
https://vincent-chk.github.io/dsh-ponytail/market/index.json
```

`npm publish` is prepared in [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md); the package is not
on npm yet.

> **Not the npm package named `dsh-ponytail`.** This bundle is
> `@dsh-ext/dsh-ponytail` and installs from this repository or the index above.
> An unrelated npm package uses the bare name `dsh-ponytail` and targets an old
> DSH generation; installing it fails with a compatibility error (see
> [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)).

Toggling the bundle off in the Plugins page removes the rules and all six
skills; toggling it back on restores them.

## Change the level

Add an override row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — the loader replaces
the row's complete `config`, so restate the level you want:

```yaml
- id: ponytail
  name: '@dsh-ext/dsh-ponytail'
  config:
    defaultMode: lite   # off | lite | full | ultra
```

HMR recomposes on the patch change; if it does not, toggle the bundle off and on
in the Plugins page. `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` overrides the row config. Resolution
order: `PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE` > row `defaultMode` > `full`.

## Not ported, on purpose

- The Claude Code statusline/band and the local HTML board: DeepSeek Harness
  already shows token and cache usage, and the band is a Claude-private API.
- The `/ponytail` level command and its state file: the bundle switch is the
  control, and the level is deployment configuration. The upstream sentence in
  the rules was adapted to say so.
- Per-project levels: the level is process-wide. `shortcut:` the upgrade path is
  registering the section per `agent.ctx` keyed by session cwd.
- `/ponytail default <mode>`: the default is row config, not a command.

## Verify

`npm test` runs two checks: `test/selfcheck.mjs` asserts the level grammar,
frontmatter parsing, level filtering, deactivation matching, and that all six
bundled assets are complete; `test/bundle-check.mjs` runs the real `apply()`
against a fake Cordis context and asserts the injected rules follow the
configured level, no command is registered, no state file is written, the
deactivation listener empties the section, and the skill provider serves all six
skills with registry-valid definitions.

On macOS volumes that store extended attributes as AppleDouble files (exFAT,
some network mounts), a write beside `locale/*.json` can leave a `._*.json`
companion that the Harness locale reader rejects as a language file;
`npm run clean:macos` removes them, and the self-check fails until it does.


## Troubleshooting

**`dsh-ponytail@0.2.0` is incompatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (requires
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`, `dsh-commands`, `dsh-llm`, `dsh-settings`, `dsh-skill`,
`dsh-system-prompt` at `^0.1.0-rc.6`)**

That message comes from the unrelated npm package `dsh-ponytail@0.2.0`
(published 2026-08-15, built for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6), not from this bundle. Uninstall
that package in Plugins, then install this repository instead:
`github:Vincent-chk/dsh-ponytail`, the Git URL, or the market index above. This
bundle declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer requirements and its
`engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`.

## License

MIT; see [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) for provenance. Skill bodies are upstream
content (`ponytail` and `ponytail-help` adapted for this host).

plugins.description: A kitchen of DeepSeek Harness sessions: stations, tickets, long jobs, and the bell that wakes them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dkitchen

[![Tests](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin)](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/releases/latest)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin)](LICENSE)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a repository into a kitchen: stations, tickets, long
jobs, and the bell that wakes a session when its job finishes.

Installing the bundle is the whole installation. The tools are registered inside the harness
process through `ctx.tools`, so there is no package to install, no separate profile to boot, no
broker to start, and no MCP server to spawn. Nothing else needs running.

> **Based on [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen).** The kitchen itself — the
> stations, the ticket workflow, the house rules, and the bell that wakes a session — is the
> design of [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen), and this plugin is its port
> to the DeepSeek Harness plugin runtime. See [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements).

## Install

**From Discover.** In the harness, open **Plugins → Discover**, add this index

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/main/docs/market/index.json
```

and install `dkitchen`. The index pins an exact commit of this repository, so what you get is
what a release names.

**From a release.** Download the source archive of a tag from
[Releases](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/releases), then point
**Plugins → install bundle** at the unpacked directory.

Either way the harness composes `cordis.patch.yml` into the profile and loads `index.js`.
Restart the harness if it does not pick the bundle up by itself. On first start the bundle also
installs the setup skill into the machine-wide skill root, so `/setup-dkitchen` works in every
project.

A bundle that fails to register a tool does so silently — the process keeps running and the
tool simply is not there. Set `debug: true` in `cordis.patch.yml` to have each registration
reported on stderr.

## What it gives a session

| Group | Tools |
| --- | --- |
| Sessions | `dkitchen_new_session`, `dkitchen_send`, `dkitchen_read`, `dkitchen_info`, `dkitchen_rename`, `dkitchen_list_sessions`, `dkitchen_board`, `dkitchen_session_status` |
| Long jobs | `dkitchen_launch`, `dkitchen_logs`, `dkitchen_stop`, `dkitchen_run_status` |
| Tickets | `dkitchen_relay`, `dkitchen_merge`, `dkitchen_log`, `dkitchen_executor_status` |
| Watching | `dkitchen_watch`, `dkitchen_watch_state` |
| Configuration | `dkitchen_config`, `dkitchen_check_refs`, `dkitchen_status` |

The ticket tools need the `gh` CLI. Without it they say so and the rest keep working.

## How a repository configures its kitchen

Each call resolves `.dkitchen.toml` from the repository the session works in, never from the
directory the harness happened to start in — one harness process serves many repositories.

```toml
repo = "owner/name"

[kitchen]
stations = ["orchestrator", "designer", "verifier", "executor"]

[harness]
default_provider = "trae"
default_model = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"

[models.executor]
model = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"

[approval]
allow = ["dkitchen_*"]
```

`dkitchen_status` reports what one repository resolved, and `rootSource` says how that
repository was chosen: `argument`, `session`, or `process`. A `process` answer means the
repository was guessed rather than known.

## Two deliberate behaviours

**`[approval]` answers by rule, and defers by default.** The harness already asks the user
through its own panel, so a plugin that answered ahead of it would remove that decision.
Naming a tool under `allow` answers it without asking, which is what makes an unattended
kitchen able to run what it was configured for; anything else calls `next()`. With no
`[approval]` section the plugin changes no permission behaviour at all.

**A background job's settlement arrives as a session notice.** `ctx.jobs` announces it, so a
session that launched work does not have to poll.

## The page this bundle adds

`client.js` adds a section to this bundle's page in **Plugins**. It reports whether the bundle
is installed and enabled, and says where a repository's configuration lives. It has no
buttons, because nothing here needs running.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Mounting the plugin: injected services, per-call config resolution, tool registration |
| `lib/` | The tools and the rules behind them |
| `kitchen/` | The station rules the setup skill renders into a repository |
| `skills/setup-dkitchen/` | The setup skill, with a renderer that needs only Node |
| `scripts/market.mjs` | Generating and validating `docs/market/index.json` |
| `docs/plugin.md` | The user-facing guide: installing, every tool, every `.dkitchen.toml` key |
| `tests/` | The suite: `node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` |

This repository is the bundle: `package.json`, `index.js`, and `lib/` are at the root, which is
why the market index names it without a `path`.

## Development

```bash
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"     # the suite; nothing to install first
node scripts/market.mjs index --check
```

On Windows under a restricted shell, `node --test` cannot spawn its per-file child processes;
run `node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "tests/*.test.mjs"` there instead.

Releasing: bump `version` in `package.json`, then push a matching tag such as `v1.0.0`. The
release workflow checks the two agree, runs the suite, regenerates the market index for that
tag's commit, and publishes the GitHub release.

## Acknowledgements

This plugin is a port, not an original design. The kitchen it implements — stations with fixed
duties, work handed off through GitHub issues as tickets, the status block every comment opens
with, the rules for when a station must stop and ask, and the bell that wakes a session when its
long job exits — comes from **[917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen)**, and this
repository follows its functional design closely on purpose: the vocabulary, the refusals, and
the order in which the orchestrator does things are all meant to match. Thank you to
917Dhj/dkitchen for thinking it through and writing it down.

What differs here is the runtime, not the kitchen. That project drove DeepSeek Harness sessions
from outside the process — a CLI, a broker, an MCP server, a separate profile. This one
registers the same tools inside the harness through `ctx.tools`, so installing the bundle is the
whole installation. The behaviour is meant to stay the same; where this port had to choose, the
choice is recorded in the commit that made it and in the tests.

The metaphor, and much of the workflow, traces further back: the Michelin-kitchen way of running
agents comes from Lauren Tan ([Poteto](https://github.com/poteto)), and the practice of keeping
tickets on GitHub issues started from the issue tracker setup in
[Matt Pocock's skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 插件：通过 IMAP/SMTP 收发邮件，支持 QQ/163/126/Gmail/Outlook 等多服务商与附件上传下载
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mail

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用的**多邮箱收发插件**：让 agent 直接读信、搜信、发信、回信，并且**上传附件与下载附件**。

支持 QQ / 腾讯企业邮 / 163 / 126 / yeah / 新浪 / 搜狐 / 139 / 189 / 阿里云企业邮 / Gmail / Outlook / iCloud / Yahoo / Zoho / Fastmail，也可以填任意自建 IMAP/SMTP 服务器 —— 走的是标准 IMAP/SMTP 协议，不是某个厂商的私有接口。

- 纯 Host 插件，安装即给 agent 增加 8 个 `mail_*` 工具，不需要额外服务进程。
- 附件是**一等公民**：`mail_send` 直接读本地文件作为附件发出，`mail_read` 可把附件落盘。
- 凭证永不进入模型可见的输出，也不会回显到设置界面（不可枚举字段 + 密文角色 + 单测断言）。
- 自带 191 项离线测试，`npm test` 即可跑，不需要任何邮箱账号。

---

## 目录

- [安装](#安装)
- [配置邮箱账号](#配置邮箱账号)
- [QQ 邮箱授权码怎么拿](#qq-邮箱授权码怎么拿)
- [各服务商预设](#各服务商预设)
- [工具参考](#工具参考)
- [用法示例](#用法示例)
- [附件上传与下载](#附件上传与下载)
- [安全说明](#安全说明)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [开发](#开发)
- [发布到插件市场](#发布到插件市场)
- [许可](#许可)

---

## 安装

**先确认你用的是哪个 profile** —— 这一步搞错，装完什么都不会出现。

DSH 的 profile 是**互相独立**的：装在 `web` 里的插件，桌面端（`desktop`）看不到，反之亦然。

| 你平时怎么用 DSH | 该装进哪个 profile | 怎么装 |
|---|---|---|
| 桌面应用（`DSH NEXT.exe`，Electron） | `desktop` | **只能用图形界面**（命令行装不了，见下） |
| 命令行启动的网页版（`dsh web`） | `web` | 命令行或图形界面都行 |

### 桌面应用（Electron）用户

**命令行装 `desktop` 会被直接拒绝**，这是 DSH 的硬性设计：

```
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

所以请走图形界面：打开左侧栏的 **插件** 页面 → 安装第三方插件 → 填包名
`github:charonpi/dsh-mail`（或本机目录的绝对路径）。

### 命令行 `dsh web` 用户

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:charonpi/dsh-mail
```

本地开发时用 link（源码留在可写目录里，改完重启即可）：

```bash
cd /path/to/dsh-mail && npm install
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-mail
```

> `dsh plugin add` 会把这个包写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并叠加插件的
> `cordis.patch.yml`。**不要手工编辑** profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。

> ⚠️ **npm 上的 `dsh-mail` 不是这个插件**。这个名字已被他人占用，本项目**没有**发布到
> npm，所以 `dsh plugin add dsh-mail` 会装到别的包。请一律用上面的 `github:` 形式。

安装之后**重启 DSH**，`mail_*` 工具才会出现（改账号配置本身不需要重启，见下）。

安装完可以先让 agent 调一次 `mail_accounts`，它会直接告诉你账号配好没有。

---

## 配置邮箱账号

### 推荐：左侧栏的「邮件」页面

装好之后，DSH **左侧栏会多出一项「邮件」**（在「插件市场」和「自动化任务」之间）。点开是主区里的一个独立页面：

1. 填**邮箱地址**（例如 `123456789@qq.com`）。
2. **服务商**可以留空，会按域名自动识别；也可以在下拉里选 qq / 163 / 126 / gmail / outlook 等。
3. 填**授权码**（不是登录密码）。
4. 点**保存**，立刻生效，**不需要重启**。

页面里还能看到已保存的账号、编辑（密码框留空 = 不修改已存的授权码）、删除。

**授权码永远不会被回显**：页面列出账号时，服务端只告诉它「已存 / 缺授权码」，
不会把明文发回浏览器；只有在你输入新值时才上行。

这个页面是 DSH 的**正式客户端插件**（`lib/client.js`）：向宿主注册 `sidebar.panellist`
一个入口、`main` 一个页面，不是往页面里塞脚本。所以它跟「插件」「Skill / MCP」那些入口是同一套东西。

账号存在一个独立文件里，**不动** DSH 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

| 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/dsh-mail/accounts.json` | 有 profile 目录时（每个 profile 一份） |
| `~/.dsh/dsh-mail/accounts.json` | 没有 profile 目录时的兜底 |
| `$DSH_MAIL_DATA_DIR/accounts.json` | 自定义（测试时用这个） |

这个文件里的账号**优先于**配置文件里的同名账号 —— 你刚在页面上改过，就该以页面为准。
配置文件里独有的账号仍然会被列出（页面上单独标为「来自 cordis.patch.yml」）。

> **看不到那个入口？** 客户端插件是宿主启动时加载的，**改完插件代码必须重启一次 DSH**
> （设置面板右上角「重启」→「重启」；「重新加载界面」不够）。
> 实在没有就退回下面「直接写 config」，数据是同一份。

### 备选：在设置页里填

本插件还声明了配置 schema，DSH 会据此尝试**自动生成设置表单**。若你的版本里能看到
**插件 / 设置 → dsh-mail**，效果等价：在「账号」列表里加一项，填 `address` / `provider` /
`password` 即可。保存同样立即生效。

### 一个必须说清的取舍：授权码会明文落到配置文件里

表单里的值最终写进你 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（插件配置就存在那里）。

`role('secret')` 保证的是**授权码不跨进程进入浏览器界面、不进日志**（插件内部对它有专门的脱敏处理与测试），**它不等于磁盘加密**。

如果你不想让明文留在配置文件里，把授权码放进**环境变量或文件**，然后在表单里填**变量名 / 文件名**（这三栏也在表单里）：

| 表单里填 | 实际存放位置 |
|---|---|
| `authCodeEnv: QQMAIL_AUTH_CODE` | 授权码在环境变量里，配置文件里只有变量名 |
| `passwordEnv: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD` | 同上 |
| `passwordFile: D:/secrets/qq.txt` | 授权码在一个独立文件里（内容是明文，请自行收紧权限） |

设置环境变量（Windows，改完要重启 DSH 才能被读到）：

```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('QQMAIL_AUTH_CODE', '十六位授权码', 'User')
```

macOS / Linux（写入 shell 配置后重启 DSH）：

```bash
export QQMAIL_AUTH_CODE='十六位授权码'
```

### 也可以直接写 config

设置页读写的就是这一份数据，直接编辑等价：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mail
      name: dsh-mail
      config:
        defaultAccount: qq          # 多账号时必填；只有一个账号可省略
        attachmentDir: mail-attachments   # 附件默认落地目录（相对会话工作目录）
        maxBodyChars: 20000         # 单封正文回传给模型的最大字符数
        timeoutMs: 30000            # 连接/命令超时
        accounts:
          - id: qq
            label: QQ 邮箱
            provider: qq            # 见下方预设表
            address: 123456789@qq.com
            authCodeEnv: QQMAIL_AUTH_CODE
```

只要一个账号时，`provider` 都可以省 —— 会**按邮箱域名自动推断**：

```yaml
        accounts:
          - id: gmail
            address: you@gmail.com
            passwordEnv: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD     # 自动推断出 imap.gmail.com / smtp.gmail.com
```

> 手写的 config 会被 schema 校验。校验刻意做得**很宽容**：字段类型写错（比如 `port: "993"`）、写了没用的多余字段、账号填了一半，都**不会**让插件加载失败 —— 只会在 `mail_accounts` 里报告具体哪一项缺什么。这样你永远不会遇到「插件装上了但工具不见了，还不知道为什么」。

### 授权码的解析顺序

在同一个账号里，插件按这个顺序取第一个有值的来源：

| 顺序 | 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `password` / `authCode` / `token` | 表单里直接填的值（明文存在配置文件里） |
| 2 | `passwordEnv` / `authCodeEnv` / `tokenEnv` | 从该环境变量读 |
| 3 | `passwordFile` | 从该文件读，取首尾空白后的内容 |
| 4 | *自动推导的环境变量* | 什么都没配时，找 `DSH_MAIL_<ID>_PASSWORD`（大写，非字母数字换成 `_`）。`id: qq` → `DSH_MAIL_QQ_PASSWORD` |

### 账号字段一览

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 账号标识，工具里用 `account` 参数引用它。留空会用邮箱地址自动生成。 |
| `address` / `email` | 完整邮箱地址，同时作为默认登录用户名。 |
| `provider` | 预设 id、别名或裸域名（如 `163.com`）。省略时按 `address` 的域名推断。 |
| `label` | 显示用的名字。 |
| `userName` / `user` | 登录用户名，默认等于 `address`（有些服务器要求不带 `@域名` 的短名）。 |
| `imap` / `smtp` | `{ host, port, secure, requireTLS? }`。写了就**完全覆盖**预设。 |
| `senderName` | 发信时的显示名。 |
| `replyTo` | 发信时固定带的 Reply-To。 |
| `signature` | 自动追加到纯文本正文末尾的签名（已包含则不重复追加）。 |
| `sentFolder` / `draftsFolder` / `trashFolder` | 手动指定这些特殊文件夹；默认按服务器的 SPECIAL-USE 标记自动识别，并回退到常见名字（`Sent`、`已发送`、`Sent Messages`…）。 |
| `appendToSent` | 发信后是否把副本追加进「已发送」。默认 `true`。 |

---

## QQ 邮箱授权码怎么拿

QQ 邮箱**不接受**你的 QQ 登录密码，必须用「授权码」。步骤：

1. 用浏览器登录 <https://mail.qq.com>。
2. 顶部点 **设置 → 账户**（新版可能在 **设置 → 账户 → POP3/IMAP/SMTP/…服务**）。
3. 找到 **IMAP/SMTP 服务**，点 **开启**。
4. 按提示用手机发送一条验证短信；验证通过后，页面会弹出一串 **16 位授权码**。
5. 复制它（**只显示一次**，关掉就看不到了；忘了就重新生成）。
6. 回到 DSH，打开 **插件 / 设置 → dsh-mail**，添加一个账号：
   - `address` 填 `你的QQ号@qq.com`
   - `provider` 留空即可（会按域名自动判断成 QQ 邮箱）
   - `password` 粘贴那 16 位授权码
7. 保存后让 agent 调 `mail_accounts` 确认状态是「可用」。**不需要重启。**

不想让授权码明文留在 profile 配置里的话，改成在第 6 步填 `authCodeEnv: QQMAIL_AUTH_CODE`，
并按[上一节](#一个必须说清的取舍授权码会明文落到配置文件里)设置同名环境变量（那种情况下需要重启 DSH 一次）。

QQ 的 IMAP 服务器有个已知的挑剔点：连接后如果客户端不发 `ID` 命令，会返回 `Unsafe Login`。本插件已经内置发送客户端标识，正常情况下不需要你处理。

> QQ 的企业邮（`exmail`）是另一套服务器，用 `provider: exmail`。

---

## 各服务商预设

`secure` 为 `true` 表示从第一个字节就走 TLS；`587` 那几行走明文连接后升级 STARTTLS。

| `provider` | 名称 | IMAP | SMTP | 密码字段里该填什么 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qq` | QQ 邮箱 | `imap.qq.com:993` TLS | `smtp.qq.com:465` TLS | 16 位授权码 |
| `exmail` | 腾讯企业邮 | `imap.exmail.qq.com:993` TLS | `smtp.exmail.qq.com:465` TLS | 登录密码或专用密码 |
| `163` | 网易 163 | `imap.163.com:993` TLS | `smtp.163.com:465` TLS | 授权码 |
| `126` | 网易 126 | `imap.126.com:993` TLS | `smtp.126.com:465` TLS | 授权码 |
| `yeah` | 网易 yeah.net | `imap.yeah.net:993` TLS | `smtp.yeah.net:465` TLS | 授权码 |
| `sina` | 新浪邮箱 | `imap.sina.com:993` TLS | `smtp.sina.com:465` TLS | 授权码 |
| `sohu` | 搜狐邮箱 | `imap.sohu.com:993` TLS | `smtp.sohu.com:465` TLS | 登录密码或独立密码 |
| `139` | 中国移动 139 | `imap.139.com:993` TLS | `smtp.139.com:465` TLS | 通常为登录密码 |
| `189` | 中国电信 189 | `imap.189.cn:993` TLS | `smtp.189.cn:465` TLS | 通常为登录密码 |
| `aliyun` | 阿里云企业邮 | `imap.qiye.aliyun.com:993` TLS | `smtp.qiye.aliyun.com:465` TLS | 邮箱密码 |
| `gmail` | Gmail | `imap.gmail.com:993` TLS | `smtp.gmail.com:465` TLS | **应用专用密码**（需先开两步验证） |
| `outlook` | Outlook / Microsoft 365 | `outlook.office365.com:993` TLS | `smtp.office365.com:587` STARTTLS | 应用密码；**多数账号已停用基础认证，需要 OAuth2** |
| `icloud` | iCloud 邮箱 | `imap.mail.me.com:993` TLS | `smtp.mail.me.com:587` STARTTLS | App 专用密码 |
| `yahoo` | Yahoo Mail | `imap.mail.yahoo.com:993` TLS | `smtp.mail.yahoo.com:465` TLS | App password |
| `zoho` | Zoho Mail | `imap.zoho.com:993` TLS | `smtp.zoho.com:465` TLS | App password（跨数据中心要自己填 `imap/smtp`） |
| `fastmail` | Fastmail | `imap.fastmail.com:993` TLS | `smtp.fastmail.com:465` TLS | App password |

**预设只是便利，不是限制。** 任何预设之外的邮箱，直接写 `imap` 与 `smtp` 即可：

```yaml
        accounts:
          - id: work
            address: me@example.com
            passwordEnv: WORK_MAIL_PASSWORD
            imap: { host: imap.example.com, port: 993, secure: true }
            smtp: { host: smtp.example.com, port: 465, secure: true }
```

## 工具参考

安装后 agent 会多出下面 8 个工具。

### `mail_a

plugins.description: Always-on draggable task lens for DeepSeek Harness: local, zero-token step reconstruction and focused progress UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-lens

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的「任务透视」插件：结合你的请求、AI 计划、工具调用和错误还原任务步骤，
把 AI 正在做的事翻译成人话，用状态灯和进度条告诉你现在到哪一步，并把踩过的坑记下来给下一次任务用。
**不调用模型，不额外消耗 token。**

![dsh-task-lens](assets/screenshot-1.png)

## 你会得到

- **步骤跟着任务走**——先识别你让它做的是绘图、编码、文档、数据、调研还是配置，再给出对应步骤。
  例如画图会依次显示「构思构图与配色 → 绘制边框与轮廓 → 铺设底色 → 涂色 → 调整光影 → 导出」，
  编码则显示「定位问题 → 阅读代码 → 修改代码 → 补充测试 → 运行测试 → 检查构建 → 整理结果」。
  编码、配置和一般任务还会从实际工具操作里还原步骤：区分前后端、合并同一区域的连续写入、补上尚未
  发生的验证步骤；也会读取 AI 的思考内容与编号计划，推进到当前那一步，不额外调用模型。
- **工具调用说人话**——`pwsh`、`read`、`grep`、`edit`、`web_fetch`… 全部翻成「正在运行测试」
  「正在修改 login.tsx」「正在搜索『submitting』」这样的中文动作，命令、文件、搜索词都带你到现场。
- **带星体的真实进度条**——优先使用 AI 写下的任务清单；没有清单时按当前步骤在计划中的位置推进，
  一轮正常结束时归 100%，中止时不会假装完成。完成段有彩色流光和从左向右流动的星星，进度原点使用
  轻轻摇动的 DeepSeek 娘图片，完成后整段变绿。
- **状态灯一眼分辨**——进度条旁只有一盏灯：读取、搜索、分析是蓝色；写入、修改、安装是黄色；
  运行、测试是青色；完成是绿色；出错或连接中断是红色。步骤行内不再放灯，避免到处都是亮点。
- **主面板只留三步**——始终聚焦「已完成 / 正在做 / 下一步」，不用在长列表里找当前位置；简洁模式
  也保留这三行。下面还有一行会随思考更新的「思路」摘要，每个阶段只留一句话。每一步带出具体动作、
  代码首行、命令或目标文件，`ops_bash` 会显示命令、脚本、目录和超时。把鼠标放上去可看完整内容，
  密钥会自动打码。
- **详情页看完整步骤**——点「详情」先用一段较长的思路摘要解释当前判断和下一步，再列出全部步骤、
  每步状态和详细动作；不展开原始思考过程。做前后端编码时能直接看到读取了哪些文件、改了哪一层、
  测试和构建是否已经补上。
- **进度会继续走**——编码拆成 7 个阶段，文档、数据、调研、配置等拆成 6–7 个阶段；当前阶段内再按
  工具调用数量与耗时推进，长命令执行时也不会长时间停在同一个百分比。运行中追加要求时会重新预估，
  进度先按新增工作量回调，再随新的工具操作继续增长。
- **常驻面板**——启用后一直显示；没有任务时进入待命状态，不会消失。默认浮在输入框上方；
  按住标题栏即可拖动到任意位置，位置会被记住，双击标题栏恢复默认。多线程或窄窗口会自动缩窄并
  限制高度（最多 55% 屏高），重复注入的面板节点会被清理，尽量不挡住主内容。
- **详情页与设置**——标题栏的「详情」包含任务翻译、当前工具、较长的思路摘要、完整步骤和最近操作；
  「设置」可调面板大小、自定义宽高（320–900 × 220–900）、信息密度（简洁 / 正常 / 详细）、
  5 种背景颜色，并查看当前经验，全部自动保存。
- **收起只留重点**——收起后保留状态灯、星体进度条、百分比和一句当前任务报告，随时可以再展开。
- **错误经验自动积累**——失败原因翻成中文（文件不存在 / 权限不足 / 端口占用 / 依赖没装 /
  超时 / 限流 …），重复出现的会合并计数，重试成功后自动标记「已解决」并移出提示。
- **下次任务自动避开**——经验会写进 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 里的受管区块，宿主本来就会加载它，
  所以后续会话无需你做任何事就能看到（默认上限 10 条、1200 字符，超出自动折叠）。
- **不花 token**——翻译、步骤、进度、经验整理全部是本地规则，没有模型调用、没有外部请求。

## 安装

桌面端：**设置 → 插件**，搜索 `dsh-task-lens` 安装，刷新页面即可。

命令行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-lens
```

把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名即可（例如桌面端 profile 由应用自己管理，请在应用的插件页里装）。

装好后输入框上方会出现面板；运行任意任务时它开始工作。按住标题栏可以拖动，双击标题栏回到默认位置。

想单独看悬停详情效果，打开 `assets/demo.html?hover=1`；想看没有任务时的待命面板，打开 `assets/demo.html?idle=1`：

![悬停查看步骤详情](assets/screenshot-2.png)

![任务详情页](assets/screenshot-3.png)

![设置、背景与当前经验](assets/screenshot-4.png)

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里改（桌面端插件卡片里也可以改）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-task-lens
  name: dsh-task-lens
  config:
    showPanel: true
    showThinking: false
    lessonsEnabled: true
    lessonsMax: 10
    lessonsMaxChars: 1200
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showPanel` | `true` | 是否注入输入框上方的浮层面板（关掉后仍在后台记录经验） |
| `showThinking` | `false` | 在 AI 思考、尚未调用工具时也显示一句「正在分析下一步」 |
| `lessonsEnabled` | `true` | 是否记录错误经验并写入 `AGENTS.md` |
| `lessonsMax` | `10` | 写进 `AGENTS.md` 的条数上限 |
| `lessonsMaxChars` | `1200` | 受管区块的字符上限（控制 token 成本） |
| `pollMs` | `400` | 面板轮询间隔（仅本地读取，不消耗 token） |
| `keepDoneMs` | `120000` | 任务结束后保留任务数据多久，之后回到待命面板（面板不会消失） |
| `instructionsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` | 经验落地的指令文件 |
| `lessonFile` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-task-lens/lessons.json` | 经验数据文件 |

## 经验是怎么工作的

1. 工具返回错误时，按 `error.code` 与错误文本归类成中文结论。
2. 同一工具 + 同一目标 + 同一报错会合并为一条，并累计重复次数。
3. 排序后写入 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 的受管区块（`<!-- dsh-task-lens:begin -->` … `<!-- dsh-task-lens:end -->`），
   区块之外的内容一个字符都不会动；上限之外自动截断。
4. 后面同一工具在相同目标上成功时，该条会被标记为已解决；只剩已解决的条目时受管区块会被完整移除。
5. 原始记录留在 `~/.dsh/dsh-task-lens/lessons.json`，方便你手动查看或删除。

不同工具、不同目录、不同报错算不同条目——不会因为一次失败就把整类工具都记成不可用。

## 隐私与安全

- 所有处理都在本机完成，插件不发任何网络请求、不上传任何内容。
- 经验里的路径会做脱敏：`$DSH_HOME` 与用户主目录分别折叠为 `$DSH_HOME` 和 `~`。
- 面板用的本地接口只接受 `GET`，并且要求环回地址、同源、`Sec-Fetch-Site` 不是 `cross-site`。
- 插件是本地代码，请你自行审阅后再安装。

## 开发

```sh
npm test
```

`npm test` 会先对 `lib/` 做语法检查，再跑无依赖的冒烟测试（伪造宿主组合、模拟会话事件，
校验任务识别、步骤计划、进度、翻译与预览脱敏、经验落盘、`AGENTS.md` 受管区块与接口安全）。

预览界面：直接用浏览器打开 `assets/demo.html`（自带演示数据，不需要宿主）。

发布：

```sh
npm publish
```

打 `v*` 标签会触发 GitHub Release 工作流（见 `.github/workflows/release.yml`），
需要仓库 Secret `NPM_TOKEN`。

## 许可

MIT
